messages:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026.03.21-rc4 to production complete (42% -> 100%)
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke jobs started: prefill-probe, kv-warmup, embed-synth (ETA 3m) :rocket:
alice: seeing a couple of transient OOMs in eu1-prefill pods, small tail of restarts, not all hosts
ben: paste of kube events from eu1: 
```
Events:
  Warning  OOMKilled  pod/prefill-xyz    2m  kubelet
  Normal   Pulled     pod/prefill-xyz    2m
  Normal   Created    pod/prefill-xyz    2m
  Warning  OOMKilled  pod/prefill-abc    1m
```
carol: synthetic prefill probe p95 for eu1 jumped from 120ms -> 800ms at 1776654300, but overall 5xx rate for route is still within SLO (0.2% -> 0.5%)
alice: looks like OOMs coincide with high batch sizes on a subset of nodes, probably kv-cache warmup plus larger batch windows
sre-oncall: tagging infra, dropping nodename and pod logs: `kubectl logs prefill-xyz -n inference --previous`
ben: logs show repeated allocation spikes around the same window, stacktrace snippets point to kv-cache growth: `kv_cache.resize`
carol: quick check: can we reduce prefill batch_size on the eu1 canary group while we triage? small config change, no restart of the whole rollout
alice: +1 to soft-mitigate, do a targeted config flip on eu1 only and re-run the prefill probe
sre-oncall: I'm on it, applying config flip to eu1 prefills to batch_size=8 (was 32) via k8s configmap patch, will monitor
ben: patch applied, controller rolled out to 4 pods, restarting gracefully :white_check_mark:
carol: prefill probe p95 back to ~160ms within 90s, no new OOM events in last 2m
alice: ok this is a soft-fail scenario (minor subset, recovered with config tweak). recommendation: continue global rollout but pin eu1 to v2026.03.21-rc4 with batch_size override until follow-up fix
sre-oncall: agree. I'll open an incident-lite and keep prefills pinned in eu1 for 6 hours, then re-evaluate. filing: INF-2026-042
ben: follow-up action items: 1) investigate kv-cache growth root cause (dmitri) 2) autoscaler threshold review (sre) 3) consider prefill warmup phasing to avoid simultaneous growth (runtime)
carol: can we add a quick smoke test to catch batch-size related OOMs in nightly runs? add to checklist: spawn high-prefill-rate job on a single node
alice: noted. I'll write short postmortem note for release notes: "Minor eu1 prefill OOMs observed post-rollout, mitigated by reducing prefill batch_size. No customer impact. Pinned eu1 config while we investigate."
sre-oncall: closing loop for now, monitoring for 30m then we'll unpin if stable :eyes:
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke summary: prefill-probe (eu1) degraded -> mitigated by config override; no rollback required; incident INF-2026-042 created
carol: thanks all, marking this thread for release notes and follow-up triage tomorrow morning
